summary: Owner told via Zalo when the price-alert check stops. Implemented 2026-09-25 on feature/epic-002-fix-alert-monitoring (12deea3..6434eef), not pushed/deployed. Artifacts in Vietnamese.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Spec approved 2026-09-25. Concern 1: option B - watcher runs on a different free scheduler than cron-job.org (<=5 min cadence).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Scope: owner only, price-alerts only (9am digest monitoring = separate epic). Reminder every 6h; watcher silent 30 min -> check notifies owner. Defaults accepted.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Implemented in 8 commits (12deea3..6434eef): run outcomes, rejected-call counting (1 EVAL/min/instance, per-minute fields in a per-UTC-day hash), pure evaluateMonitor/evaluateWatchdog, /cron/price-alerts-watch + PriceAlertsMonitorService, watchdog in the check every 5th minute, outage-aware report, DEPLOYMENT 8a/8b. Unit 132->185, e2e 20->23 (+3 opt-in Redis).

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Upstash budget still an estimate (~295k/339k per month): owner skipped the pre-step-4 dashboard baseline. Check Upstash Usage after deploy; >320k -> watchdog every 10 min, MONITOR_RUNS_WINDOW 20.

entries.text: npm run lint (eslint --fix) rewrites CRLF working copies (core.autocrlf=true) to LF, making many unrelated files look modified. Stage only epic files; consider a .gitattributes chore.

entries.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
entries.text: Deploy order: env PRICE_ALERTS_WATCH_SECRET + OWNER_CHAT_ID -> vercel deploy --prod -> curl watch endpoint -> create QStash schedule */5 with Upstash-Forward-X-Cron-Secret-Token -> report within 5 min -> disable cron-job.org ~20 min to test AC17.

reflections.author: Thach <vnsnake123@gmail.com>
reflections.text: Walking the failure order after writing the watcher found the same class of bug in the watchdog path (delivered but unsaved -> repeats every 5 min). Next time: when two code paths share a send-then-persist pattern, factor the anti-spam rule once instead of re-deriving it per path.
